main_text.p: nus ufuramq; cepisti, & alios avare per injuriam fruaudasti, oblita mei, inquit Dominus Iova. Ezech.22.

Nónne patrem unum habemus nos o-mnes? nónne nos Deus unus creavit? cur prodit frater fratrem, profanando no-strum fœdus patrium? Proditor est Iu-daus, fitq; nefas in Israelitis ac Hierosolymis: siquidem profanat Iudaus fanum Iovæ quod amavit, peregriniq; Dei puellam maritat. Evertet Iehova virum qui id fecerit, vigilantem & respondentem ex Iacobæis tabernaculis, & fertum armipotenti Iovæ obmoventem. Adde quod efficitis, ut obtegatur lachrymis ara Iovæ ploratu ac suspiriis, ita ut non amplius ferta respiciat, neque placamina ex vestra manu admittat. Quaretis, quamobrem? quoniam Iova tibi & tuæ juventutis uxori conscius est, in quam tu perfidiosus es, cùm sit tua socia, & tibi fœderata conjunx. Quod si unus fecit qui spiritu abundabat, quorsum allegatur unus ille[?], qui divinam progeniem

page.notes: Printed text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page; the paragraph continues on the next page. "Iu-daus" and "o-mnes" keep the printed line-end hyphens. "ille[?]": the mark after "ille" is a small stroke, possibly an abbreviation, and is not clear. "X C." is printed as a bare numeral and letter in the text block, so it is a paragraph, not a heading. "Ezech.22." stands at the end of the first line of the continuing paragraph, inside the text block, not in a margin.
